title: Inter 2–0 Stuttgart: Sučić and Lautaro score, Bastoni a doubt for Genoa
caption:
Inter beat Stuttgart 2–0 at San Siro: Sučić scored a penalty and Lautaro added a second off the bench, per Inter.it. The win lifts Inter to 12th in the Champions League with nine points. Bastoni went off before halftime, and Sky Sport Italia reports a sore left thigh, with his place against Genoa on Saturday at risk. Blue means the club said it. Pink means only the papers did.
